data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, September 23, 2026: Crypto prices open near 8-month highs. Is the crypto winter over?
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $86,195.28 on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, flat compared to Tuesday's opening price. As of 7:26 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin moved lower to $85,600.03. Ethereum opened at $2,753.25 today, down 0.8% from Tuesday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved down this morning to $2,725.32 as of 7:26 a.m. ET.
